description: Idon Wuta (Eye of Fire), Kano, Nigeria. A 3D globe app: search any place on Earth, see real NASA fire detections from the last 24 h and get fire alerts near you. Our AI forecasts next month’s fire risk, the likely fire type and class (A-K), how to prevent it and what to do (call 112). At its core, machine learning merges 25 years of NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire data into one burning calendar, tested on years it never saw. Hausa/English. We welcome ML, web and design skills.
